en:
It was one day, with summer vacation right around the corner...
I was heading to the newspaper club room, my finally finished manuscript in hand.
This issue's feature: the school's seven wonders.
...Looking back, maybe my fate was sealed the moment Hino brought this project to me.
So much happened, starting with the seven wonders interviews.
So much that it was a real struggle to put the article together.
But since I struggled that hard, I'm actually kind of proud of this manuscript.
I wonder if Hino will praise me?{p}

"I was talking it over with the president...
I know I can leave the newspaper club in your hands.
I'm lucky to have such a dependable junior."
...What'll I do if he says something like that?
Being president is a big role, way too much for me...
But turning it down would ruffle feathers, wouldn't it?
President {a}...
That sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?
......Or am I getting ahead of myself?
Hee hee hee...{p}

Okay, here's the club room.
Is Hino here already?
In high spirits, I knocked on the club room door.

"Oh, it's you, {a}.
So you finally finished the manuscript?
You sure took your time.
Well, anyway, I'll read it later, so could you just leave it over there?"
...Huh?
That's it? That's all?{p}This isn't what I imagined at all.
Leave the manuscript and go home
Ask him to read it right now

"Hino...!
Don't say that. Please read it now, right here.
I risked my life doing those interviews...
I worked so hard to put the article together...
If you don't have much time, even just skimming it would be fine.
Please, I'm begging you!"
...I pleaded with all my heart.{p}

"All right!
All right already, don't crowd me like that."
Maybe my intensity overwhelmed him, because Hino's eyes went wide as he nodded over and over.
Then he hurriedly picked up my manuscript.
"If you're pushing this hard, you must be pretty confident in what you wrote."
"Of course I am."
I answered, full of confidence.
"I see..."
With just that, Hino quietly began to read the manuscript.
At first it seemed like he was just glancing over it, but gradually his expression grew serious...
He finished reading it in no time.{p}

If he read it all in one go, that means it was well put together and easy to read, right?
...So, what's he going to say?
If he praises me to the skies, would it be more graceful to act modest?
Or would it be cuter to just be openly happy about it?
Oh, my heart's pounding...{p}

"{a}..."
Tapping the pages of the manuscript into a neat stack, Hino slowly began to speak.
"Yes!"
Full of hope, I waited for his next words...
...And?{p}

"...It's no good."
...Huh?
"I can't use something like this."

"The writing's clumsy, and the structure's weak.
And I spotted quite a few typos and missing words too.
This isn't some grade-schooler's essay, you know...
I need you to write a much more solid manuscript than this.
And besides...
It's supposed to be seven wonders, and there are only six stories.
Even if it's just a club activity, I can't use an article this unfinished."
......That's so mean.
Hino, you didn't have to tear it apart that much...{p}

"It was too early to put you in charge of planning the feature, {a}.
Well, don't let it get to you.
...You can go home now."
B-but...
After all that hard work, that's all he has to say?{p}And on top of that, he's scrapping the article I worked so hard on......
Beg him for one more chance
Meekly back down

"Huh?
What are you talking about?
It's still beyond you, {a}.
Come on, hurry up and go home."{p}
Hino wouldn't hear a word of it and all but chased me out of the club room.{p}

"Hino...!
...Hino!"
I pounded on the club room door, calling his name.
...I want just one more chance!
And then...?
The door opened with a click, and Hino's face peeked out.{p}

"{a}...
I'm meeting someone after this.
We can't talk with you around, so hurry up and go home, will you?"
And then the door slammed shut with a bang.{p}

...Ugh!
So he won't even listen.
Nyeeeh!

I... I lost my temper and kicked the door.
...Just then.
"{a}...?"
Suddenly, a voice came from behind me.{p}

Startled, I turned around to see a boy I didn't know standing there.
...Who is he★
Oh no, he saw me doing something awful.
I'm so embarrassed I can't even look at his face...
I don't care what happens to the seven wonders anymore.
I just want to get away from here...
"Ah...
G-goodbye..."
Keeping my head down so our eyes wouldn't meet, I hurried away.{p}

The boy...
The newspaper club room grew farther and farther behind me.
"Hey, Sakagami.
There's something I wanted to ask you.
Come on, get in here..."
Far behind me, I heard Hino's delighted voice.
...Sakagami?
Is that the boy's name...?{p}

I'm a little curious, but... oh well.
He seems to know Hino, so I'll just ask about him tomorrow or something.{p}

...The next morning.
"Heeeey, {b}!"
On my way to school, a voice called out to stop me.
I felt a pat on my shoulder and turned around...{p}

...Oh, it's just Fukuzawa.
"Morning, {b}.
Hey, there's something I wanted to ask you.
When's that seven wonders thing from the other day going to be in the paper?
I can't wait to read it..."
...Urk!
She's hitting a sore spot first thing in the morning...{p}
She'd be upset if I told her the article got scrapped, wouldn't she?{p}Hmm, but then again, it'd be wrong to get her hopes up for nothing...
Honestly tell her the truth
Fudge it somehow
Tell her what she wants to hear

"Oh, that...
...Hmm, when will it be, I wonder?
I'm not really sure myself.
Sorry about that.
Aha, ahahahaha..."{p}

"Hmm, is that so?"
"Yeah, that's how it is.
Ahaha...
W-well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll go on ahead.
...Bye!"{p}
Fudging my way through it, I dashed away from there.

"Ah, wait......"
Fukuzawa was saying something as she chased after me, but I couldn't stop to listen.{p}

I have to hide somewhere before I slip up.
...Getting into the classroom fast is my best bet.{p}

I rushed up the stairs and ran for the Class 1-E classroom at the end of the third-floor hallway.
Three more meters...
Two meters...
One meter...
Made it...!
...The instant I thought so, a figure suddenly appeared right in front of me.{p}

Before I could even think 'Ah...', I was lying on the hallway floor.
I'd collided with the figure.
"Ugh..."
The other person was crouched down too, clutching their head.
Ah...
And who should it be but Arai.
For an instant, an unpleasant thought crossed my mind.{p}
...Could it be that he came looking for me?{p}About that seven wonders thing......
Run away from there
Stay and see what happens
...I'm sure that must be it!{p}

The moment I thought that, I sprang to my feet and ran off.
"Ah, {a}!
Please wait...
Is it true our stories won't be made into an article?
I just heard something to that effect.
That's a lie, isn't it★
{a}...☆"{p}

...I'm sorry.
It's true...
I'm sorry...!
Apologizing in my heart, I desperately searched for somewhere to escape.
Somewhere...
Wasn't there anywhere I could be alone?
Somewhere......{p}

...That's it!
My feet carried me to the girls' restroom on their own.
Arai can't follow me in here.
As I stopped to catch my breath, thinking that, the stall door right in front of me suddenly opened......{p}

"Eeeeek!☆"
H-Hosoda...★
This is the girls' restroom.
So why is Hosoda in here★
"Hey, if it isn't {a}.
Did you come because this restroom caught your interest too?
You're really something.
There's a terrifying spirit in here, you know.
That's why I'm investigating it."
"...Uh-huh."{p}

"{a}...
I hear that seven wonders article from back then got scrapped?"
......Gulp!
"And so they're holding the meeting again, right?
The rumor is that this time a first-year boy from the newspaper club is coming to do the interviews."
"A first-year boy from the newspaper club...?"
"Yeah.
I think his name was... Sakagami or something."
"Sakagami...?"
That's the name I heard in front of the newspaper club room yesterday.
I see, so it was the name of a new member...{p}

"Huh, you don't know him?
That's strange...
I mean, he's supposed to be in the same class as you, {a}."
"The same class... as me?"
"That's right.
Shuichi Sakagami, of Class 1-E."
...Class 1-E is definitely my class.
But was there a student like that?{p}

"I'm thinking of getting them to invite me to that meeting again.
Just like I got to be friends with you, {a}, I want to be friends with this Sakagami too.
I want lots of friends, after all.
Hey, {a}.
Could you put in a word with Sakagami for me too, so he'll invite me to the seven wonders?
I'll have a really special story ready..."{p}

...Sakagami?
...Shuichi Sakagami?
"I don't know him..."
"Huh?"
"I don't know anyone like that!"{p}
That was all I screamed before I burst out of the restroom.{p}

Who on earth is he?
There's no student named Sakagami in my class.{p}
After making sure Arai wasn't around, I ran into the classroom.{p}I have to find out about this Sakagami!
Check the attendance register
Ask a friend
I hurriedly opened the attendance register on the teacher's desk.{p}

Sakagami...
Sakagami...
Sakagami...
...No way!
Why is his name here?{p}

But I don't know anyone like that!
All sorts of thoughts were swirling round and round in my head.
It felt like if I let them be, I'd be swallowed up in the swirl myself, and my vision swam.
Who on earth is this Sakagami★
...Just then, someone tapped me on the shoulder.{p}

"What's wrong, {a}?
Why the gloomy face first thing in the morning...?"
My heart jumped, but I recognized that voice.
"Hino★"{p}

"Yo.
So you're in 1-E too, {a}.
Well, I hardly ever come to the first-year classrooms.
Today I've got some business with Sakagami...{p}You know where he is?"
Say that I know
Say that I don't know

"I don't know..."
I shook my head as I answered.{p}

"I see...
Looks like he's not here yet...
Oh well.
When he gets here, tell him to come to the club room after school today.
If you say the message is from me, he'll understand."
...No way!
How am I supposed to pass a message to a classmate I didn't even know existed★{p}

"Well, see ya. I'm counting on you.
I've got a lot going on.
Now I've got to go get things settled with the last one."
Saying that, Hino was just about to leave when...!
"Morning, Sakagami..."
I heard someone say that out in the hallway.{p}

Hino's eyes lit up.
"Ah, looks like Sakagami's here.
{a}...
Forget that message from before.
I'll tell him myself."{p}

"Huh? Hino★"
Hino ran off down the hallway, ignoring me as I tried to stop him.{p}

By the time I hurried out into the hallway, his back was just about to disappear at the far end of it.
There had definitely been another boy beside Hino.
That had to be Sakagami.
I missed seeing his face again.{p}

How am I ever going to meet him...?
Now that I think of it...
Hino said 'the last one' just now.
...Which means...
There must be a seven wonders interview after school today.
In the newspaper club room......{p}

...In the end, after school came around without my ever having met Sakagami once.
We both go to every class like we're supposed to, yet I never catch even a glimpse of his face.
On top of that, today was nothing but classes where boys and girls are split up, like home ec and P.E.
I can't help thinking it's some kind of conspiracy.{p}

But...
Apparently the second seven wonders interview is about to be held in the newspaper club room.
If I go there, I'm bound to meet Sakagami.
The same class...
The same club...
...And yet I can't even picture his face. That's definitely weird.
Today I'm going to see with my own eyes just what kind of person he is.
I pulled myself together with a firm look and headed for the newspaper club.{p}

Gloomy gray clouds blanketed the whole sky. It could have started raining at any moment.
Even the wind was muggy, clinging to my skin and refusing to let go.
...Just like that time.
Is it a rule that the weather is always like this on seven wonders days?{p}
While I was thinking about that, I reached the newspaper club.{p}

When I opened the club room door, twelve eyes turned on me all at once.
Six boys and girls sat around the big table in the middle of the club room.
...Really, every last detail was exactly the same as that time.
They were all unfamiliar faces...
...None of last time's members were here.
Well, never mind that. Where's Sakagami......?{p}It looks like he isn't here yet.
I'll come back later
I'll wait here for a while

Oh well.
I'll wait here for a while.
...Though this time I'm not one of the participants, so I can't exactly take a seat and wait.
Whatever, I'll just wait standing up.{p}
I decided to stand beside the door and wait.{p}

And then...
"Um, aren't you going to take a seat?"
One of them asked me, almost in a murmur.
"Oh, I'm..."
The six of them were staring at me with puzzled faces.
"I'm... not the seventh one."
I got so nervous that it was all I could manage to say.
"Then you must be the newspaper club member who's going to hear our stories.
Hino told us about you.
He says you're the club's rising star."
One of them nodded, as if that settled it.{p}

"I heard about you too.
Let me see... Your name is Sakagami, isn't it?"
...What★
W-wait a minute!
"Hee hee hee hee...
I'm so pleased.
To think the one who came to interview us would be such a lovely boy."{p}

Me, Sakagami...?
A lovely boy...?
What is everyone talking about★
Just then...
...What★
I was stunned when I saw my reflection in the window glass.
Reflected there was a boy in a white dress shirt.
I looked away in a panic, so I didn't get a good look at the face...
But that was definitely me.
What on earth has happened to me...?{p}

"Well then, shall we get started?"
Paying no attention to my confusion, the six began their scary stories of things that happened at school.
But the real seven wonders had already begun.
At least, inside me...
When this meeting is over, who on earth will I have become......{p}

"...All right.
Then I'll leave the manuscript here, so please make sure you read it later."
"Yeah, I know.
I'll read it, I promise."{p}

Reassured by his words, I left the club room.
...But I'd barely gone a few steps when the club room door opened,{p}

"Hey, {a}.
Come here a sec..."
...and Hino beckoned me over.
Has he read it already?
Full of excitement, I went back into the club room.{p}

I'd somehow lost all my enthusiasm.
Manuscript in hand, I trudged dejectedly to the door.
"...Goodbye."
I said it curtly and went out.{p}

...And just then, I heard Hino muttering to himself.
"If I'd known it would turn out like this, I should've had Sakagami do the interviews from the start..."
...Sakagami?
Who could that be?
Was there anyone like that in the newspaper club?
Hmm, I still don't really know everybody yet.{p}

"Actually, you see...
that article got scrapped."{p}

"What...?"
...Oh no!
Fukuzawa looked like she was about to cry.
I had no choice but to cover it up.
"J-just kidding!
It's a joke, a joke.
That thing...
Even I'm not really sure when it'll come out.
It might be tomorrow...
It might be five years from now...
Aha, ahahaha..."
"Five years...?"
"Hmm, or was it three years...
Ahaha...
W-well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll go on ahead.
...Bye!"{p}
I fudged it as best I could and dashed away from there.{p}

"Oh, that?
Geez, it was printed ages ago.
...You haven't seen it yet?
That's weird.
I'm sure it was posted on the bulletin board too...
Maybe somebody tore it down?"{p}

"Really...★"
"Y-yeah, really.
Hmm, I wonder if there are any copies left at the newspaper club...
I don't think there were any left.
I know...!
I'll go to the club room and check for you.
And if there aren't any left, you'll just have to give up.
Ahaha...
There probably weren't any left, so...
W-well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll go on ahead.
...Bye!"{p}
After rattling off a string of glib lines, I fled from there as fast as I could.{p}

"Ugh..."
Rubbing his back and legs, he raised his head...
...Oh no!
Our eyes met dead on.{p}

The moment they did, Arai's eyes lit up.
"{a}...
Thank goodness. I've been waiting for you."
...he said, pressing in close to me.
"{a}...
Is it true that our stories won't be made into an article?
Just now, I overheard Hino talking with someone.
That's a lie, isn't it★"
Arai's eyes were strangely bloodshot, glittering with an eerie light.
Is this what the face of someone possessed looks like?
My body was frozen with fear, yet my mind was idly thinking things like that.
But...
"{a}!"
...The instant Arai grabbed my arms, those thoughts flew right out of my head.{p}

Ugh, it hurts...!
It hurts...☆
Arai's fingers were digging into my skin.
Maybe his nails had pierced it; there was even a faint ooze of blood...
Where does he get that kind of strength...?
...Both my arms were going numb.
The pain was so sharp I couldn't even cry.
I felt like my whole body would come apart...☆
Why is this happening to me...★{p}
Thinking that, I started to get kind of angry.

"Let go of me already☆"
The instant I screamed it, I shoved Arai away with all my might.
Arai staggered and reeled backward, then fell onto the hallway floor again.
I never knew I had that kind of strength...
So it's true that anger can turn you into a different person.{p}

...Wait, this is bad.
If anyone saw me here like this, I'd be in big trouble.

The instant that thought struck me, I sprang to my feet and fled from there.
"Ah, {a}!
Please wait!
Please tell me it's a lie☆"{p}

...I'm sorry.
It's true...
I'm sorry...!
Apologizing in my heart, I desperately searched for somewhere to escape.
Somewhere...
Wasn't there anywhere I could be alone?
Somewhere......{p}
It wasn't Arai's voice...
Turn around
Keep running
Who is it this time...?
I turned around fearfully.{p}

...What I saw was Shindo.
"What's wrong, rushing around like that...{p}

"What, you haven't heard yet?
You're as out of the loop as ever.
That's why the article you worked so hard to research got scrapped."
......Gulp!
He already knows.{p}

"See, the thing is,
some guy who said he was a first-year in the newspaper club came up to me a while ago and spilled the whole story."
"What!"
...Who★
Who on earth would say something like that☆
"And then he asked me to please take part, since they're holding the meeting again..."
...Does that mean they're redoing the whole interview?
Nobody told me anything about that.
Does it mean I've got nothing to do with it anymore...★
"So...
Did you say yes?"
"Nah...
I haven't answered him yet.
The guy just did all the talking and took off.
What was his name...
Oh yeah, he said Sakagami.
You're in the newspaper club too, so you know him, right?
What a scatterbrain, huh?"{p}

...Sakagami?
Was there anyone like that in the newspaper club?
I've heard that name somewhere... but who was it?
If that person went and talked to Shindo, does that mean this Sakagami is the one doing the interviews?{p}

"It's nice of 'em to invite me, but I've got no plans to go.
I don't wanna pull any more dangerous stunts.
I'm sick and tired of the seven wonders.
So I've been looking for him to turn it down, but I can't find him anywhere.
{a}...
You're in the newspaper club too, right?
If you see Sakagami, tell him I said that."
"Huh? Shindo?"
"See ya. I'm counting on you."{p}

With that, Shindo gave my shoulder a couple of pats and walked off.
...Somebody named Sakagami.
I don't even know him...
I think Shindo's a pretty big scatterbrain himself...{p}...Anyway, maybe I should try looking for this Sakagami person.
I'll do that
On second thought, I'd better not

Yeah, I'll do that.
It's bugging me so much I can't stand it.
But come to think of it, I don't know a thing about Sakagami.
...For now, I'll try going to the newspaper club.{p}

I started down the stairs.
Just then...
"{b}..."
Suddenly, warm breath blew across the nape of my neck.
"Eek!"
A chill shot up my spine, my foot slipped, and my body was flung out into the air.{p}

Instead, I felt something soft and feathery wrap gently around me.
......What?
What happened...?
...When I fearfully opened my eyes...?{p}

Right in front of me was a familiar, friendly smile!
"K-Kazama★"
"Hey, that was a close call.
Missing a step on the stairs... You're more of a klutz than you look, aren't you?"
Kazama was holding me in his arms like a princess, beaming.
...Did he just save me?
But wait a minute...
I didn't miss a step.
It happened because Kazama did something weird!{p}

"Say, {b}.
Running into each other here must be fate.
Let's go on a date, you and me."
"What are you talking about!
I've got more important things to deal with."
I shook off Kazama's arms and stood on the landing on my own two feet.{p}

"Ahaha...
Shy as ever, aren't you?"
Talking to this guy just wears me out.
"{b}...
Do you know what this spot is called?
It's called an 'odoriba,' a landing.
In other words, a place for 'odori'... for dancing.
Come on, you've gotta dance, baby."
"Wh-what?"
Why does this guy always march to the beat of his own drum?{p}

"Come on, music!
......Zun-taka-tat-ta, tan-ta-tan.
Tan-tan-tat-tan, hm-hm-hmm-hm......"
Humming a dubious tune, Kazama started doing some sloppy dance steps.
As I watched in a daze, he twirled round and round to the right, to the left, then hopped and bounced.
Nozomu Kazama......
A great man, in more ways than one.
I tried to quietly slip away.
And then...{p}

"{b}, aren't you going to dance?
Come dance with me.
Don't worry.
I'll lead you perfectly!
...You can look for Sakagami after that, can't you?"
Honestly, Kazama...!
But...
...Wait a minute!
He definitely just said Sakagami.
I never said a single word to Kazama about him...★{p}

"Hey, Kazama!
Do you know Sakagami?"
"Now, now, that's naughty...
Saying another man's name while you're with me.
Are you trying to tease me like that?
But I won't lose.
Not even if my rival in love is your classmate Sakagami.
Heh, after all, there's nobody who can beat me!"
"My classmate...★"{p}
Leaving Kazama behind, I broke into a run.{p}

I pretended I hadn't heard the voice and tried to keep running.
I'd had enough of getting mixed up in more trouble.
But...
"Hey, {a}.
Hold on a second!"
The moment the voice called out, a hand shot out and grabbed me firmly by the shoulder.
...Geez!
Who on earth is it★{p}

But then......
No way, Arai's still there!
What do I do...
I'd better hide somewhere a little longer.
But where should I go...{p}

...That's it!
I just have to ask my friends!
"Hey...
Does anybody know Sakagami?"
I raised my voice and asked.
Loud enough to ring through the whole class...
And then...?
"Haven't seen him yet today."
"Isn't he just late?
He's been coming in late lately."
"Wow, {a}, is a guy like Sakagami your type?"
"You're both in the newspaper club, so you must need him for something, right?"{p}

...Sakagami's...
...Sakagami, honestly...
Everyone's voices came surging at me like a tidal wave!
Does everyone know Sakagami★
Am I the only one who doesn't...?
...Why?
...How come?{p}

"Oh, yes..."
...I know him.
That's what I'd been about to answer.
After all, he's my classmate and my clubmate. I'd be too embarrassed to admit I didn't even know Sakagami existed.
But at that very moment...{p}

"I hate liars."
...A voice I recognized spoke right by my ear.{p}

I spun around, but no one was there.
...Was I hearing things?
A chill crept down my spine.

...You're right, I'll stop lying.
I can't shake the feeling that that person is watching me from somewhere.
I just have to answer honestly.
And say it with a smile...{p}
I turned on my heel and started to leave.{p}
